resolution.note: own enforced records listed in OWN-INDEX.md beside the pack index, whole sentences, byte budgets asserted, drift test

title: The standards index lists each repository's own enforced rules in whole sentences
body:
Source: lead handoff 2026-11-16 after #1181 (t-0sp26bn, 7154e85): the generated standards INDEX.md holds only the shipped pack; KRN's own enforced `s-ci-*` records (b3a8cf4, .agents/standards.json) are not shown to agents up front, and index rules are cut to the first sentence and mostly end in "...".
Outcome: the standards skill index lists each repository's own enforced records (a repo-local section or second generated file) next to the pack, every rule shown as a whole sentence without a trailing "...", and the generator's drift check fails when either list is stale; the index stays within a measured byte budget recorded in the test.
Why: agents learn a repository's own CI rules only after a red Check; first-push-green is the brain metric.
Proof: a test generates the index for a fixture repo with one own record and finds it listed with its full sentence; a test asserts no index line ends in "..."; the drift check exits 1 after an own record is added and the index is not regenerated.
